title: Enable npm package provenance (SLSA)
description: Add --provenance to npm publish for SLSA Build Level 1. Requires publishing from GitHub Actions with id-token: write permission. Lets users verify package origin.
acceptance_criteria:
- Provenance in publish workflow
- Package shows provenance badge on npmjs.com

title: Add dependency-review action to CI
description: Add GitHub's dependency-review-action to block PRs introducing known-vulnerable dependencies. Free for public repos, catches supply chain issues at PR time.
acceptance_criteria:
- Action added to ci.yml
- fail-on-severity: high configured

title: Add CI-based npm publish workflow
description: Move npm publishing from local machine to GitHub Actions. Create .github/workflows/npm-publish.yml triggered on release tags, with environment protection rules and NPM_TOKEN as environment secret. Include --provenance flag for build attestation.
acceptance_criteria:
- Workflow created with environment protection
- NPM_TOKEN in environment secret (not repo)
- Dry-run tested
- Docs updated

title: Add CODEOWNERS for security-critical paths
description: Create .github/CODEOWNERS to require maintainer review for security-sensitive paths (SECURITY.md, src/gateway/auth/**, src/tools/**, package.json, .github/workflows/**). Prevents accidental merges to sensitive code.
acceptance_criteria:
- CODEOWNERS file created
- PR to protected paths triggers review request

title: Document npm maintainer redundancy
description: Recommend adding second npm maintainer for bus factor. Document process in CONTRIBUTING.md or SECURITY.md. Both maintainers should have npm 2FA enabled.
acceptance_criteria:
- Documentation section added
- Process for adding maintainer described
